# @oubble/corners

> iOS-calibrated capsules and continuous (smoothed) corners for HTML elements,
> through `clip-path`, without wrappers, SVG or dependencies. ESM, SSR-safe.

Use Corners when a design asks for iOS-looking shapes: fully rounded buttons,
chips and tags, and cards, tiles or buttons with continuous corners. Works in
every engine, unlike `corner-shape: squircle` (Chromium only).

## Install and enable

```sh
npm i @oubble/corners
```

```js
import '@oubble/corners' // once, in the app entry. Mounts every [data-corners] element, now and later.
```

```html
<button data-corners class="cta">Continue</button>
```

CDN, no build step: `<script src="https://unpkg.com/@oubble/corners"></script>`

## Rules

- The element's own `border-radius` picks the shape: none or a full radius
  gives the capsule, a smaller one a continuous corner of that radius.
  `--corners-smoothing: 0..1` (default 0.6) sets how smooth.
- The element's own `background` becomes the fill. Keep styling it
  with normal CSS.
- Change fill on hover or other states with `--corners-fill`, not `background`:
  `.cta:hover { --corners-fill: #0a84ff }`. Class changes are picked up
  automatically; `:hover` and inline style changes are not.
- Shadows: `filter: drop-shadow(...)`. Never `box-shadow` (renders a
  rectangle, warning OUB001).
- Outlines: `data-corners-stroke="2"` plus `--corners-stroke: <color or gradient>`.
  Never `border` (renders a rectangle, warning OUB002).
- `::before` is reserved on mounted elements (warning OUB003). Put icons in
  children.
- Optional no-JS fallback: `[data-corners] { border-radius: calc(infinity * 1px) }`.
- Transforms, filters, transitions, focus styles and events work as usual.

## Frameworks

The attribute is the whole API: render `data-corners` in React, Vue, Svelte,
Solid or Astro and import `@oubble/corners` once. For explicit lifecycles use the
side-effect-free entry:

```ts
import { mount } from '@oubble/corners/core'
useLayoutEffect(() => mount(ref.current!), []) // returns its cleanup
```

Web components: call `observe(shadowRoot)` from `@oubble/corners/core`.

## API

- `@oubble/corners`: auto entry, re-exports everything below.
- `@oubble/corners/core`: `mount(el): () => void`, `unmount(el)`,
  `observe(root?, { selector? }): () => void`.
- `@oubble/corners/geometry` (no DOM): `capsulePath(width, height, x?, y?)`,
  `capsuleRingPath(width, height, thickness)`,
  `roundedPath(width, height, radius, smoothing?, x?, y?)` and
  `roundedRingPath(width, height, radius, thickness, smoothing?)` return SVG
  path data for `clip-path: path()`, `<path d>`, `Path2D` or canvas.

## Constraints

- Strict Content Security Policy is supported (styles go through the CSSOM).
- Browsers without `clip-path: path()` keep the element's own CSS.

## Links

- Source and full documentation: https://github.com/oubble/corners
- Live lab: https://lab.oubble.com/corners/
